reused_contract.reason: This contract is already explicitly documented as 'a strategy-neutral, prospective definition of the minimum evidence and economic performance a strategy/version must demonstrate' -- not written for or tuned to any one strategy. Semantically appropriate for Large SMC's G3 evaluation without modification. No new, Large-SMC-specific numeric thresholds were authored -- reuse only, per this mission's instruction to reuse generic signed governance contracts where appropriate and never choose thresholds by searching Large SMC's own results for values that pass.

policy_summary_as_of_this_mission.failure_behavior: economic_gate.py: any bound violated -> EDGE_REJECTED; g3_gate.py maps this to GateStatus.FAIL
policy_summary_as_of_this_mission.missing_evidence_behavior: economic_gate.py: incomplete evidence/sample -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; g3_gate.py maps any non-PASS (including this) to GateStatus.BLOCKED
policy_summary_as_of_this_mission.g3_downstream_blocking: g3_gate.g3_blocks_downstream(result) returns True for any status != PASS -- unchanged, not modified by this mission

why_not_signed: config/governance/economic_gate_contract.yaml itself remains identity.status=PROPOSED repository-wide (verified unchanged by tests/test_economic_gate_evaluator.py::test_real_contract_file_is_proposed_not_signed). This mission does not sign it, does not create a Large-SMC-specific fork of it, and does not choose different threshold values for Large SMC.
admission_effect: Because the reused contract's status != SIGNED, StrategyValidationProfile.validation_policy_ref for ST_LARGE_SMC_V1/EURUSD remains None -- VALIDATION_ADMISSION will continue to report MISSING_VALIDATION_POLICY until an owner signs config/governance/economic_gate_contract.yaml (a repository-wide decision, not Large-SMC-specific).
